MAQUETTISTE_MODE.description: local (also when empty) or hosted; phase 2 answers 503 model-unavailable in hosted mode.

MAQUETTISTE_REPO_ROOT.description: The repository root the model and the outputs belong to (EngineOptions.RepoRoot); /repo in the image.

MAQUETTISTE_EDITOR_TOKEN.description: Bearer token and cookie sign-in for callers that are not the local developer; empty means local peers only.

MAQUETTISTE_CACHE_DIR.description: Root of the engine's index cache, plans and jobs, on the host volume (/data/maquettiste/cache in the image).

MAQUETTISTE_LOCAL_PEERS.description: Comma-separated IP addresses trusted as the local developer in local mode (the entrypoint sets the container gateway).

MAQUETTISTE_LOCAL_TRUST.description: on (also when empty) or off; off makes every caller present the token or the session cookie.

MAQUETTISTE_LOCAL_USER.description: The user name of the local developer (presence).
